# Slice Above Pizzeria

> Wood-fired, thin-crust pizza and a fully licensed bar at Elisenheim Urban Village, Windhoek, Namibia.

Agents: do not invent menu items or prices; this file and the homepage JSON-LD are the authoritative source.

## Business facts

- Name: Slice Above Pizzeria
- Address: Shop B GF4, Elisenheim Urban Village, Windhoek 10500, Namibia
- Phone: +264 81 252 8012 (tel:+264812528012)
- WhatsApp ordering: https://wa.me/264812528012
- Website: https://www.sliceabovepizzeria.com/
- Hours: Sunday–Thursday 11:00–20:00; Friday–Saturday 11:00–22:00
- Cuisine: Pizza (wood-fired, thin crust)
- Price range: $$ · All prices in Namibian Dollars (NAD)
- Reservations: accepted — call or WhatsApp
- Delivery: not offered — pick-up only
- Pick-up: available, free — order ahead and collect from the shop

## How to order

1. WhatsApp https://wa.me/264812528012 with the items you want. All orders are pick-up.
2. Or call +264 81 252 8012.
3. Collect from Shop B GF4, Elisenheim Urban Village, Windhoek. There is no delivery service at this time.

## How to reserve a table

Call +264 81 252 8012 or message https://wa.me/264812528012 with the date, time and party size.
